title: [Project] GDevelop-Unlocked
author: Heretek-ai
selftext:
I have been working on a patching system for GDevelop to allow users to provide their own AI endpoint instead of having to use GDevelop subscription service. Along with that it also unlocks other features such as "subscription/capability unlocks, checker no-ops, logo/watermark + preview/debugger gate removal"

its in active development with both a dedicated opencode plugin and mcp server beng created.

On top of that the newest release adds a really good debugging log that is super useful for development: "gdevelop-unlocked --heretek-debug-log \~/gdevelop-debug.log"

If you run into errors that debug log will provide all the calls and requests the agent made and that helps me track down bugs.

We also offer a homebrew tap for linux:  
**brew** tap Heretek-AI/tap  
**brew** install gdevelop-unlocked

comments.author: Heretek-ai
comments.body: Also this is like the 4th time ive tried this, the patching system seems to work a lot better than the forking methods I tried before.
